summary.text: David Blom, a Republican, represents District 52 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Blom as serving a first term and as a union sheet metal worker.

paragraphs.text: The biography says Blom attended Marshalltown High School and received an associate's degree from Marshalltown Community College.
It says Blom was born in 1997 in Des Moines and lives in Marshalltown.
